description: Public Service Commission - Notify the amendment to the Service Minute of Sri Lanka Principals Service that published in Gaz. Ex. No. 2076/14 of 19.06.2018
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to an amendment of the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals Service, which is a public sector service regulation. It involves the Public Service Commission issuing a correction to service conditions, falling squarely under the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) for public sector administration and service matters.
